### How central laboratory strategies are transforming paediatric clinical trials


Paediatric trials require a different approach to laboratory planning. Discover how low-volume sampling, sample-sparing workflows and early laboratory involvement can help generate high-quality data while minimising blood collection and reducing burden on young participants.
